install_info_text: You can easily do the hardware installation of the cameras and the computer yourself. The software works with almost every IP camera brand. In the 'Hardware Installation' section we explain everything in detail. Already have cameras? Then download the AI Detector app right away: setup runs in your browser in three short steps. Afterwards, 'Using the App' explains every page and setting.
install_card_hardware_desc: Read all about the required cameras, the computer, and how to install them correctly.
install_card_software_desc: Is your hardware ready? Download the AI Detector app for Windows, Mac or Linux and follow the setup.
install_card_options_desc: A tour of every page: recordings, cameras, detectors, alerts and settings.
